title: Multi-Tenant Feature Flags & Quotas
brief: As a platform admin, I want each tenant to be able to customize its feature flags and limits, so that tenants can differ from the organization defaults where they need to.

steps.summary: Add the tenant feature-flag and limit types plus the organization defaults
Merge the organization defaults with each tenant's overrides
Add the 429 quota error and the usage checks that wrap an operation
Add tests for config merging and quota checks, document the model

probes.question: What is the organization default for maxUsers?
A tenant overrides only { features: { refunds: false } }. Is analytics enabled for it?
A tenant with maxUsers 5 already has 4 users. withQuota is called to add 3 users at once (amount 3). What happens?

items.question: Which feature is switched off by default?
A tenant overrides { limits: { maxProducts: 10 } }. What is its monthlyOrders limit?
A tenant with maxProducts 100 has 98 products and imports 5 at once through withQuota. What happens?
options: The import is rejected: quota exceeded (429)
The import is rejected as invalid (400)

items.question: Suppose a tenant's own limits were ignored, so every tenant got the organization's limits. Would the agent's unit tests notice?
options: Yes: at least one unit test fails
No: all unit tests still pass
The tests stop with an error before any test runs
Only the type checker (tsc) would report it
